legitimacy.summary: Czechia has broadly credible and competitive national electoral institutions. The latest country indicators support meaningful voter choice, sound electoral rules and an opposition able to contest governing power. This is not a guarantee that every contest is flawless, nor a judgement about the popularity of any party.
